title: Being an isomorphism descends along flat surjective quasi-compact morphisms (Stacks 02L4)
statement: Let $h:T'\to T$ be a morphism of schemes [def-pc-scheme] which is flat [def-weil-flat-morphism], surjective [def-weil-surjective-morphism] and quasi-compact [def-weil-finite-type-morphism]. Let $\varphi:Y\to T$ be a morphism of schemes and let $(Y',p,\varphi')$ be a fibre product of $\varphi$ and $h$ [def-pc-fibre-product], with $p:Y'\to Y$ and $\varphi':Y'\to T'$, $\varphi\circ p=h\circ\varphi'$. If $\varphi'$ is an isomorphism of schemes, then $\varphi$ is an isomorphism of schemes.
